newsitem.title: NORWAY: Storebrand H1 profits seen lower.
newsitem.headline: Storebrand H1 profits seen lower.

text.p: Storebrand, Norway's largest insurance company, is expected to post a first-half 1997 group result of 494 million crowns, according to a consensus estimate of seven analysts polled by Reuters.
Storebrand had a group result of 860 million crowns in the corresponding year-ago period.
Only two analysts issued a buy recommendation on the share despite the widespread view that Storebrand may either merge with another group or enter into an alliance.
"The argument for buying the share is that the company is on the move and not because the company is reasonably priced," an analyst said.
However, several analysts said they did not believe in major structural changes until a dispute over preferential shares is resolved probably at the annual general meeting next year.
Three said hold and two said sell.
Storebrand will present the first-half result on August 27.
